summary.note: TBR uses a single-factor trust score (anomaly/packet-forwarding history only, with fast penalty and slow recovery) rather than TA-DT's 4-factor TrustEngine, so it should show meaningfully worse compromised_routes_pct and/or detection_accuracy_pct than TA-DT despite having real trust-based path avoidance -- unlike LEACH and HEED, which have no trust mechanism at all.
